The Pockit Course: Available now!

1. Create lesson cards

A Pockit Course is made up of sets of lesson cards, rapidly built using a just-right collection of learning blocks.

A lesson can be just a few cards, but you can make as many as you like.

2. Print, cut, learn and treasure

Print your lesson cards, and at the start of your class your students mindfully cut them out and slot them into their Pockit Course folder.

Oh, and they're smartphone-sized, because of course they are.

Discover the Pockit Course

The medium is the message

Cutting, holding, reading, and writing by hand plants you in your real world around and away from algorithmic concoctions.

It's the first step in reclaiming our value(s) →
